claude-code-config-lsp.reconciliation_note: 6 commits since prior observed_head (1896770). Only two touched tracked surfaces: c28078f edited schema/claude-code-config.ttl but solely to fix the settings.json model-id enum (unrelated to any known_delta below). 9f99842 ('expand config-surface validation') added hook `type` support, monitors/themes top-level-legacy warnings, and expanded agent/skill frontmatter fields, but per direct inspection of schema/claude-code-config.ttl at da7d4da, none of that work landed in the ontology itself (no hookEventType/type-enum triple, no monitor/theme class, agent/skill file patterns still only .claude/agents and .claude/skills). That is an ontology/code divergence in claude-code-config-lsp, not a narrowing of any delta below.

known_deltas.note: claude-code-config-lsp@9f99842 claims 'expand hook events 6->26, add hook `type` enum' in its commit message, but schema/claude-code-config.ttl@da7d4da (blob 1ba224e) still only carries the pre-existing 5-name TokenHookType semantic-token description (line 396) with no hookEventType/type triples. Whatever that commit changed lives in Rust code outside the ontology-driven surface; unverified whether it changed LSP diagnostic behavior. Treat as unresolved until the ontology itself models it.
